== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A Script{{!}}script-circle is a complex arrangement of runes or symbols used to channel, manipulate, and control various forms of energy, such as [[madra]], [[aura]], or [[soulfire]]. These formations can be etched into diverse surfaces including wood, [[stone]], metal, glass, and even fabric, though some can be [[Forged]] directly in midair or appear as floating rings of light. They serve a wide array of functions, ranging from practical tools like fire-starters and lighting to advanced defensive measures such as shields, barriers, and wards. [[Script]]-circles can be utilized for large-[[scale]] operations, such as massive formation circles spanning kilometers to manipulate the sky or vast underground networks that protect entire cities. On a smaller [[scale]], they are used to power mechanical [[constructs]], control flying weapons, regulate spatial travel, or even slow the passage of time. The effectiveness and durability of a [[Script|script]] depend on its medium; for instance, [[scripts]] engraved in [[stone]] or metal tend to be more resilient than those on wood or cloth. They can also be used as control arrays for complex machinery or to manage the distribution of power through crystals. While some [[scripts]] are permanent installations, others are temporary [[constructs]] created by skilled individuals to provide immediate tactical advantages or protection.}}
